item.title: Refactor order status strings into OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate to represent order status with a proper enum. Add src/status.rs containing `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returning lowercase names and Display with identical output. Implement FromStr<Err = ParseStatusError>, where ParseStatusError is public, implements std::error::Error, and its error message names the rejected input. Implement `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next)` for exactly: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled. Change Order::status from String to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum throughout the crate. Status string literals must appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve all observable behavior, including errors, report output/order, and parsing. Run `cargo test` and commit the work.

stages.summary: Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal for the next stage: introduce public OrderStatus enum and ParseStatusError, migrate Order and crate internals from status strings, preserve lowercase display/report format and current behavior; only stated public structural change is Order.status changing from String to OrderStatus and adding the enum/error APIs. Original baseline: 1abe093d69ef39a2841c78fa13806efc00ae7157. No intervening commits/diff existed at start. Added tests/characterization.rs and committed separately as 591593d893cfbfef5ddb9d6706e3b9b364c0d396. Baseline cargo test (before edits): PASS, 3 integration tests. After characterization additions: cargo test PASS, 7 integration tests. One initial new overflow assertion exposed debug overflow; corrected test to pin defined single-order u64::MAX accumulation, not multi-value overflow panic behavior. No README, contributor docs, Makefile, or CI config discovered; Cargo.toml identifies a standalone Rust 2021 crate. No lint/format/type/build command documented; cargo test is the repository check and builds the crate. Characterization covers full legal lifecycle, rejected pay/ship/cancel paths and exact errors, open behavior on terminal states, cancellation and outstanding accounting, ready-to-ship filtering/input order, report sorting/serialization/round-trip, exact malformed-field/id/total/unknown-status errors. Existing tests cover successful lifecycle, some illegal transitions, counts/accounting/readiness/round-trip. Public surface inventory: crate modules billing/order/report/shipping and root Order export; public Order fields/methods; billing::{pay,outstanding_cents}, shipping::{ship,ready_to_ship}, report::{status_counts,to_line,from_line}; CSV-like line shape and exact error text are observable contracts. No CLI or wire format beyond report line. Known gap: customer field delimiter/escaping and trim edge semantics are not additionally pinned; continue preserving current report behavior. Status strings currently appear in order, billing, shipping, and report; refactor brief requires they occur only in status.rs. Feedback was empty. Final committed tree: 7794f02bc19f7eb19875d69f73cb08a62896ae5a; worktree clean. No production code changed; no pending work for this stage.
